title: Reproduction package for "How much does each layer protect? A factorial ablation of guardrails in a Portuguese-language LLM customer-service agent"
description: Code, test payloads (Brazilian Portuguese), raw outputs and analysis scripts for a factorial ablation of five guardrails (injection detector, datamarking, personal-data masking, output validation and backend authorization) in an LLM customer-service agent for a fictitious online store, under static and adaptive prompt-injection attacks, on three models. All data are synthetic. Code under the MIT licence; test payloads, synthetic store data and outputs under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA).
